data.title: Goldman Sachs on why China is under-owned, and how Hong Kong could provide AI opportunities
data.description: Kinger Lau of Goldman Sachs said Hong Kong-listed internet platforms are becoming attractive as investors rotate out of saturated AI trades. He attributed this shift to China's strategic emphasis on AI development. While China represents 12% of the global AI market cap, international investors have only allocated 1% of their portfolios to Chinese AI equities, highlighting untapped opportunity in the region.
